name: StoreRadar – Analytics for WooCommerce
author: StoreRadar

sections.description:
Important: This plugin requires a StoreRadar account to function.
While you can install the plugin without an account, it won’t provide any value until connected to StoreRadar. Try StoreRadar for free!

StoreRadar is your WooCommerce analytics and reporting solution — built to be fast, intuitive, and powerful. Get the WooCommerce reports and insights that the default WooCommerce analytics can’t deliver: real-time dashboards, customer segmentation, subscription metrics, and cart recovery — all in one place.

Make informed decisions and grow your business with data-driven strategies. No more waiting on slow reports or juggling spreadsheets.

At a Glance

  • WooCommerce reports — Sales, revenue, products, and customers in real time
  • WooCommerce analytics — Dashboards and charts that load in seconds
  • Stock velocity reports — See how fast inventory moves and forecast restock needs
  • StoreRadar Score — One number for your store’s health and performance
  • AI chat — Ask questions about your data in plain language and get instant answers
  • Cart tracking and abandonment recovery
  • Subscription analytics (MRR, churn, LTV) for WooCommerce Subscriptions
  • Custom segmentation and filters
  • Unlimited team members at no extra cost
  • Lightweight plugin — syncs data efficiently without slowing your store

Lightning-Fast WooCommerce Reports

Say goodbye to slow-loading WooCommerce reports. StoreRadar generates detailed WooCommerce analytics, reports, and charts in seconds so you can run your operation more efficiently. Get the WooCommerce reports you need without the lag.

Comprehensive Dashboards

StoreRadar offers a range of customizable dashboards for your WooCommerce analytics:

  • Sales Dashboard — Track revenue, average order value, and top-selling products in real time. Build your custom dashboard with our drag-and-drop builder.
  • Customer Insights — Analyze customer behavior, lifetime value, and segmentation. Understand who buys and why.
  • Product Insights — See which products are selling fast, filter by category or attributes, and spot trends before they peak.

Stock Velocity Reports

Understand how fast your inventory turns. StoreRadar’s stock velocity reports show which products sell quickly and which sit on the shelf, so you can optimize reordering, reduce overstock, and avoid stockouts. Use WooCommerce analytics to see velocity by product, category, or time period and make smarter inventory decisions.

StoreRadar Score

Get a single, clear view of how your store is performing. The StoreRadar Score combines key metrics into one easy-to-understand health score. Track it over time, see what drives it up or down, and focus on the levers that matter most for your WooCommerce business.

AI Chat

Ask your data anything in plain language. StoreRadar’s AI chat lets you type questions like “What were my top products last month?” or “How did revenue compare to last quarter?” and get instant, accurate answers backed by your live WooCommerce reports. No report building required — just ask and get insights.

Subscription Analytics

For stores using WooCommerce Subscriptions, StoreRadar provides in-depth subscription analytics. Track Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR), churn rate, and the lifetime value of subscription customers — the WooCommerce reports and metrics that subscription businesses need.

Cart Tracking & Abandoned Cart Recovery

StoreRadar tracks cart events and contents so you can recover abandoned carts and understand where visitors drop off. Use your WooCommerce analytics to improve checkout and boost conversions.

Team Collaboration

StoreRadar supports unlimited team members at no extra cost. Share dashboards and WooCommerce reports with your whole team.

How It Works

  1. Sign up for a StoreRadar account at storeradar.com
  2. Install and activate the StoreRadar plugin
  3. Connect your store to your StoreRadar account
  4. Start getting WooCommerce analytics and insights about your store’s performance

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 7.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • WooCommerce Subscriptions plugin (optional — for subscription tracking and subscription WooCommerce reports)
  • An active StoreRadar account

Privacy

StoreRadar collects store data including: cart events and contents, subscription events (if WooCommerce Subscriptions is installed), order information, and customer information. All data is transmitted securely using industry-standard encryption.

Privacy Policy

StoreRadar collects store data including:
* Cart events and contents
* Subscription events (if WooCommerce Subscriptions is installed)
* Order information
* Customer information

All data is transmitted securely. StoreRadar follows best practices for data security and privacy.
sections.installation:
1. Create an account at storeradar.com
  2. Install the plugin from the WordPress plugin directory or upload the plugin files
  3. Activate the plugin
  4. Connect your store to your StoreRadar account — that’s it!
sections.faq:
Do I need a StoreRadar account to use this plugin?

Yes. A StoreRadar account is required for the plugin to function. Without an active account, the plugin will not provide any WooCommerce analytics or insights. You can sign up and start a free trial at storeradar.com.

Will this plugin slow down my store?

No. The plugin is designed to be lightweight and efficient. Your WooCommerce reports and analytics are generated on StoreRadar’s side, so your store stays fast.

Is my data secure?

Yes. All data is transmitted securely using industry-standard encryption. StoreRadar follows best practices for data security and privacy so your store’s information stays protected.

Does this work with WooCommerce Subscriptions?

Yes. If WooCommerce Subscriptions is installed, StoreRadar automatically tracks subscription events and provides subscription WooCommerce reports — including MRR, churn rates, and more.

Can I customize the dashboards?

Yes. StoreRadar offers customizable dashboards. You can create your own layouts, choose which metrics to display, and save multiple dashboard configurations for different purposes or team members.

What WooCommerce reports does StoreRadar provide?

StoreRadar provides WooCommerce analytics and reports for sales, revenue, orders, customers, products, categories, cart behavior, and — if you use WooCommerce Subscriptions — subscription metrics like MRR and churn. Reports are real time and customizable.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Enhanced: Improved nonce verification for better compatibility with caching plugins
  • Added: Automatic nonce refresh mechanism to handle cached pages
  • Added: Extended nonce validation (up to 5 days for heavily cached scenarios)
  • Added: Configurable tick verification depth via filter (default: 10 ticks = 5 days)
  • Added: Detailed error logging for 403 authentication failures with cache age info
  • Added: New REST API endpoint for dynamic nonce refresh
  • Improved: Better error handling and user feedback in browser console
  • Fixed: 403 Forbidden errors on sites with aggressive caching
  • Fixed: Tracking failures on sites with security plugins
  • Performance: Reduced need for nonce refresh by 90%+ with extended validation

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Real-time WooCommerce analytics dashboard
  • Cart tracking and abandonment recovery
  • Subscription analytics (requires WooCommerce Subscriptions)
  • Custom segmentation and reporting
  • Team collaboration features
